blocks.en: Tensor recovery spans heterogeneous data structures and observation processes, calling for a representation that can adapt across modalities and tasks. We propose DiffTR, an unsupervised framework that unifies tensor completion, denoising, and hyperspectral super-resolution through coordinate-conditioned diffusion. Shared factors indexed by tensor coordinates condition a compact score network, and score matching jointly learns the factors and an implicit tensor representation from the available observations. Scalar and vector-valued outputs accommodate individual entries and entire tubes, enabling a common formulation for tabular tensors, images, and videos. The framework separates representation learning from task-specific observation modeling: reverse diffusion recovers missing values; estimation via Tweedie's formula, soft thresholding, and optional spatial consistency support mixed-noise denoising; and measurement-guided sampling transfers a prior learned from low-resolution hyperspectral observations to high-resolution reconstruction, followed by post-sampling refinement with data consistency and spectral subspace regularization. This separation makes the representation compatible with different corruption models and permits task-specific constraints to be incorporated within the same recovery framework. Experiments across multiple tensor modalities and recovery tasks demonstrate competitive reconstruction quality and the flexibility of a unified conditional generative representation. The code is available at https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR
blocks.zh: 日光回收跨越不同的数据结构和观测过程,要求有能够适应各种模式和任务的代表性。 我们提议DiffTR,一个无监督的框架,它通过协调条件的传播,统一了收发、去诺和超光谱超分辨率。 由拉诺坐标索引的共享因子条件为紧凑分数网络,分数匹配共同从现有观测中学习出因子和隐含的拉诺表示. Scalar和矢量值的输出可容纳单个条目和整个管,从而能够为表格式的收音机、图像和视频提供通用配方。 该框架将表现学习与特定任务观测模型区分开来:反向扩散恢复了缺失值;通过Tweedie的公式,软阈值,和可选空间一致性支持混合噪声去诺化;由测量制成的抽样将之前从低分辨率高光谱观测获得的一分,转移到了高分辨重建,然后通过数据一致性和光谱子空间规范化进行采样后完善. 这种分离使代表性符合不同的腐败模式,并允许将特定任务的限制纳入同一追回框架。 跨越多种呼声模式和恢复任务的实验显示,重建质量具有竞争力,具有统一有条件的基因代表的灵活性。 该代码可在https://github.com/CZY-Code/DiffTR上查阅.

blocks.en: Tensor recovery estimates an underlying tensor from incomplete, corrupted, or indirect measurements. This problem arises in sparse multiway tables, continuous-time records, RGB images, multispectral images, hyperspectral images, and videos. Applications span completion [ 1 , 2 ] , denoising, spectral super-resolution, factor analysis [ 3 ] , sequence modeling [ 4 ] , model compression [ 5 , 6 ] , and generative modeling [ 7 , 8 ] . A general recovery framework must accommodate both heterogeneous structure and heterogeneous observations. Sparse tables encode interactions among discrete entities, whereas visual tensors exhibit spatial, spectral, and temporal correlations. Missing entries, missing tubes, mixed noise, and resolution loss impose different constraints on these structures. We use MSI and HSI to denote multispectral and hyperspectral images, respectively.
blocks.zh: 从不完全、腐败或间接的测量结果中估计出一个基本的热量。 这个问题出现在稀少的多路表格、连续时间记录、RGB图像、多光谱图像、超光谱图像和视频中。 应用跨越完成[1,2],去诺化,光谱超分辨率,因子分析[3],序列模型[4],模型压缩[5,6],基因模型[7,8]. 总的复原框架必须兼顾不同的结构以及不同的观察。 平面表编码了离散实体之间的相互作用,而视觉的伸角显示的是空间、光谱和时间的相关性。 缺失的条目,缺失的管子,混杂的噪音和分辨率损失对这些结构造成了不同的限制. 我们使用MSI和HSI分别表示多光谱和超光谱图像.

blocks.en: Classical low-rank tensor recovery combines a tensor representation, an observation model, and an optimization procedure. CP [ 9 ] , Tucker [ 10 ] , tensor train [ 11 ] , tensor ring [ 12 ] , and tensor networks such as fully connected and tensor wheel decompositions [ 13 , 14 ] prescribe how latent factors or cores are contracted into tensor entries. Structure search improves the representation by adapting network topology and mode assignments [ 15 , 16 ] , but the resulting model still relies on an explicit contraction. Many methods based on implicit neural representations (INRs) extend tensor models with fixed contraction structures to continuous domains [ 17 , 18 ] . Their effectiveness therefore depends on matching the contraction structure to the data, which can be challenging when spatial, spectral, temporal, and entity-level dependencies differ across modalities.
blocks.zh: 古典低等级的拉伸恢复结合了拉伸代表,观测模型,优化程序. CP [9],Tucker [10],变压器列车 [11],变压器环 [12],以及变压器网络,如完全连接和变压器轮分解 [13,14] 规定如何将潜在因素或核心收缩成变压器条目. 结构搜索通过调整网络地形和模式任务[15,16]来改进表达方式,但由此产生的模型仍然依赖于明显的收缩. 许多基于隐含神经表达法(INRs)的方法将具有固定收缩结构的拉伸模型扩展到连续域[17,18]. 因此,其有效性取决于将收缩结构与数据相匹配,而当空间、光谱、时间和实体层面的依赖性因不同模式而异时,数据可能具有挑战性。

blocks.en: CoSTCo and POND address the restrictions of multilinear interactions through convolutional networks and Gaussian processes with neural kernels, respectively [ 19 , 20 ] . Energy-based tensor models learn entry–factor compatibility without prescribed contractions, but primarily operate on scalar entries [ 21 , 22 ] . Extending these formulations to joint tube recovery and indirect measurements requires corresponding treatment of vector-valued outputs and observation constraints. Building on these advances, we seek a common conditional diffusion framework that accommodates heterogeneous tensor modalities, scalar entries and vector-valued tubes, and task-specific observation models across completion, denoising, and HSI super-resolution.
blocks.zh: CoSTCo和POND分别通过演化网络和与神经内核的高斯过程解决多线性相互作用的限制[19,20]. 基于能量的变压器模型在不规定收缩的情况下学习条目-要素兼容性,但主要运行在scalar条目上[21,22]. 将这些配方扩展至联合管回收和间接测量,需要相应处理矢量值输出和观测限制. 在这些进展的基础上,我们寻求一个共同的有条件的传播框架,其中包含各种抗热器模式、标量输入和矢量值管,以及具体任务的观察模型,涵盖整个完成、去诺和HSI超分辨率。

blocks.en: We introduce DiffTR , a diffusion framework conditioned on coordinate-indexed tensor factors. For each mode, an R R -dimensional factor vector is associated with every index or coordinate, either retrieved from a factor matrix for discrete modes or generated by an implicit neural representation for continuous modes. Atoms that share an index within the same mode reuse the corresponding factor vector, so that their observations jointly inform its learning. The resulting factor vectors are concatenated to condition a score network. Here, an atom refers to a scalar entry or a vector-valued tube, indexed by its positions across the modes. Denoising score matching jointly learns the factors and the conditional score, and reverse diffusion recovers the target atoms. We define the representation rank R R as the feature dimension of each factor vector. By learning interactions among factors, the score network provides a flexible alternative to prescribed multilinear contractions.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了DiffTR, 传播框架 以坐标索引的拉伸因子为条件。 对于每个模式,一个R -维因子矢量与每个指数或坐标相关联,或者从离散模式的因子矩阵中检索,或者由连续模式的隐性神经表示生成. 在同一模式内共享索引的原子再利用相应的因子矢量,这样它们的观测就能共同为它的学习提供信息. 由此形成的因子向量被调和,以有条件的分数网络. 在这里,一个原子是指一个scalar条目或一个矢量值的管,按其跨模式的位置索引. Denoising分数匹配联合学习因素和条件分数,反向扩散恢复目标原子. 我们界定了RR的表示法,作为每个因子矢量的特征维度。 通过学习各种因素之间的相互作用,分数网络为规定的多线性收缩提供了灵活的替代品.

blocks.en: DiffTR adopts a unified coordinate-conditioned diffusion formulation for completion, denoising, and HSI super-resolution, with learning and recovery procedures tailored to the available observations. For completion, it learns from observed entries or tubes and generates the missing ones. For denoising, it alternates score learning, clean-value estimation via Tweedie’s formula, and sparse-noise separation, with optional spatial consistency enforcement. For HSI super-resolution, it learns from the upsampled LR-HSI, guides reverse diffusion with HR-MSI measurements, and applies post-sampling refinement to improve data consistency. Each tensor is trained on its own observations, and the number of diffusion steps can be adjusted according to its structure and recovery requirements.
blocks.zh: DiffTR采用统一的协调条件的传播配方,以完成,去诺,以及HSI超解,学习和恢复程序根据现有观测结果量身定制. 为了完成,它从观测到的条目或管中学习,并生成缺失的条目或管. 校对:Soup 对于HSI的超分辨率,它学习了经改进的LR-HSI,用HR-MSI的测量来指导反向传播,并应用了采样后的改进来提高数据的一致性. 每个收音机都根据自己的观测结果进行训练,可根据其结构和回收要求调整扩散步骤的数量.

blocks.en: The main contributions are summarized as follows: • We formulate tensor recovery as conditional diffusion over scalar entries or vector-valued tubes, where shared mode-wise factors condition a score network that learns factor interactions. • We develop an extensible, unsupervised framework that learns from each tensor’s own observations and supports completion, denoising, and HSI super-resolution across tabular, image, and video tensors via task-specific observation models. • We evaluate DiffTR across tensor modalities and recovery tasks, demonstrating competitive reconstruction quality and analyzing the effects of key components and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 主要贡献概述如下: 我们把拉伸恢复作为条件扩散到标量条目或矢量值的管上,其中共享模式因素将学习因子相互作用的分数网络作为条件。 我们开发了一个可扩展的、不受监督的框架,从每个发言者自己的观察中吸取教训,并通过特定任务观测模型,支持完成、取消和通过表格、图像和视频显示器实现HSI超分辨率。 我们评估了DiffTR各种热量模式和恢复任务,展示了具有竞争力的重建质量,并分析了关键部件的影响和计算成本。

blocks.en: Tensor completion exploits dependencies among modes to infer missing values. Classical approaches use CP, Tucker, and tensor-network factorizations [ 9 , 12 , 13 ] , unfolding-based trace norms [ 23 ] , or tensor-tensor-product models [ 24 ] . Recent work combines low-rank Tucker factor priors with spatial–spectral graph regularization to capture global correlations and nonlinear manifold structure in HSI completion [ 25 ] . Bayesian and nonparametric methods incorporate rank adaptation, nonlinear interactions, and uncertainty [ 26 , 1 , 20 , 27 ] , while continuous-time models capture temporal variation through splines or neural dynamics [ 28 , 29 , 30 ] . Neural methods learn factor-to-value mappings, continuous tensor functions, frequency-aware representations, and deep latent parameterizations [ 19 , 17 , 31 , 32 , 18 ] . EnergyTD and ScoreTR further introduce implicit distributional modeling [ 21 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 定期完成利用各种模式的依赖性推断缺失值。 古典方法采用CP,Tucker, 和 lator-network 指数化 [9, 12, 13], 正在流出的微量规范 [23], 或 lator-tensor-产品模型 [24]. 最近的工作将低等级的塔克系数前因子与空间-光谱图规范化结合起来,以获取HSI完成中的全球相关性和非线性多重结构[25]. 贝叶斯和非参数方法包含阶次适应、非线性相互作用和不确定性[26, 1, 20, 27],而连续时间模型则通过丝状或神经动力学捕捉时间变化[28, 29, 30]. 神经方法学习因子对值映射,连续的拉伸函数,频率感知表示,以及深潜参数化[19,17,31,32,18]. EnergyTD和ScoreTR进一步引入了隐含分配模型[21,22].

blocks.en: Existing formulations typically target specific output units or coordinate domains, making it difficult to jointly support scalar entries, vector-valued tubes, and side information. Prescribed contractions can also restrict expressiveness when their structure poorly matches the dependencies in different tensor modalities. DiffTR addresses these limitations by supporting scalar and tube-valued atoms within a unified conditional diffusion formulation. Mode-wise factors are retrieved for discrete indices or generated by INRs for continuous coordinates, including timestamps. A conditional score network learns their interactions without prescribing a multilinear contraction.
blocks.zh: 现有配方一般针对特定输出单位或协调域,因此难以联合支持scalar条目,矢量值的管以及侧面信息. 限定的收缩在结构与不同收缩方式的依赖性不匹配时,也可以限制表达性. DiffTR通过在统一的有条件扩散配体中支持scal和管值原子来解决这些局限性. 模式因子为离散指数检索,或由INRs生成连续坐标,包括时间戳. 一个有条件的分数网络在不规定多线性收缩的情况下学习他们的相互作用.

blocks.en: Tensor denoising combines structural priors with noise models. Tensor robust principal component analysis separates low-rank structure from sparse outliers [ 33 ] , while Schatten- p p regularization provides a nonconvex low-rank prior [ 34 ] . A concave singular-value penalty combined with gradient tensors has been proposed to balance low-rankness and smoothness in sparse-noise removal [ 35 ] . Learned factorizations and continuous tensor functions provide flexible representations [ 36 , 17 ] , while total variation (TV) and coordinate-Jacobian regularization promote spatial smoothness [ 18 ] . Score matching offers a distributional approach by estimating gradients of noise-perturbed log densities [ 37 , 38 ] .
blocks.zh: tensor denoising将结构前科与噪声模型相结合. Tensor 稳健的主元件分析将低阶结构与稀疏的外围结构区分开来[33],而Schatten-p 正规化则提供了在[34]之前的非曲线低阶结构. 已提议采用同梯度减震器相结合的整形单值惩罚,以平衡低等级和稀有噪音清除中的平滑度[35]。 所学的因子化和连续的拉伸函数提供了灵活的表示[36,17],而总的变异(TV)和协调-雅各比亚规范化则促进空间的平滑性[18]. 分数比对通过估计噪声扰动的日志密度的梯度[37,38],提供了分布方法.

blocks.en: The effectiveness of these methods depends on how well their structural priors and noise assumptions match the data. Mixed-noise recovery requires coordinated treatment of dense noise and sparse outliers, since fitting corrupted values directly can embed noise in the learned representation. DiffTR alternates score learning, clean-value estimation via Tweedie’s formula, and sparse-noise separation by soft thresholding. An optional spatial-consistency loss penalizes score differences at nearby coordinates, incorporating local smoothness into the same conditional representation.
blocks.zh: 这些方法的有效性取决于其结构前科和噪音假设与数据是否相符。 混合噪声恢复需要协调处理密集噪声和稀疏的外围噪声,因为配上腐坏的价值观可直接将噪声嵌入到学到的表示中。 DiffTR 替补得分,通过Twedie的公式进行清值估计,通过软阈值进行零星噪音分离. 可选的空间一致性损失会惩罚附近坐标的分数差异,将当地平滑度纳入同样的条件代表.
II-C 超光谱 图像超分辨率

blocks.en: HSI super-resolution combines the spectral information of an LR-HSI with the spatial information of an HR-MSI. Coupled tensor methods share latent structure between the two observations [ 39 , 40 ] . Other approaches employ generalized tensor nuclear norms [ 41 ] , nonlinear transforms [ 42 ] , or self-supervised decomposition networks [ 43 ] . Fang et al. estimate spatial coefficients in an LR-HSI-derived spectral subspace using a spatial-frequency network and data-fidelity refinement [ 44 ] . Diffusion and score-based models offer generative priors [ 45 , 46 ] , while diffusion posterior sampling uses measurements to guide reverse diffusion [ 47 ] .
blocks.zh: HSI超分辨率结合了LR-HSI的光谱信息与HR-MSI的空间信息. 组合式变压器方法在两种观测结果之间共享潜在结构[39、40]。 其他方法采用通用的抗辐射核规范[41],非线性变换[42],或自行监管的分解网络[43]. Fang等人利用空间频率网络和数据真实性改进,估算LR-HSI衍生光谱亚空间的空间系数[44]. 扩散和计分模型提供基因前传[45,46],而扩散后采样则使用测量来指导反向扩散[47].

blocks.en: Generative priors describe plausible HSI structure, while reconstruction must also remain consistent with both the LR-HSI and HR-MSI observations. Spatial blur and downsampling couple neighboring locations, requiring observation constraints that account for the full spatial and spectral degradation operators. DiffTR learns a conditional HSI score from the upsampled LR-HSI and uses HR-MSI measurements to guide reverse diffusion. Post-sampling refinement combines data consistency under both full observation operators with spectral subspace regularization, extending the common tensor recovery formulation to HSI super-resolution.
blocks.zh: 遗传学前科描述的是可行的HSI结构,而重建也必须与LR-HSI和HR-MSI观测结果保持一致。 空间模糊和下取样的邻接点,需要观测限制,以考虑到空间和光谱退化的全部操作者。 DiffTR从升标的LR-HSI中学习了有条件的HSI分数,并使用HR-MSI测量来指导反向扩散. 采样后的完善将两个全观测操作器下的数据一致性与光谱亚空间规范化相结合,将常见的拉伸恢复配方扩展到HSI超分辨率.

blocks.en: We evaluate DiffTR on tabular completion, visual inpainting, mixed-noise denoising, and HSI super-resolution. blocks.en: We evaluate DiffTR on two sparsely observed tensors [ 50 ] . Alog is a file-access log with dimensions 200 200 users × 100 \times 100 actions × 200 \times 200 resources and approximately 0.33 % 0.33\% nonzero entries. ACC is constructed from a code-repository management system and has dimensions 3 ​ k 3\mathrm{k} users × 150 \times 150 actions × 30 ​ k \times 30\mathrm{k} resources, with approximately 0.009 % 0.009\% nonzero entries. We follow the split of [ 21 ] and report five-fold cross-validation results.

blocks.en: The baselines cover deterministic, probabilistic, neural, and undirected generative tensor models: CP-WOPT [ 49 ] , GPTF [ 1 ] , HGP-GPTF [ 27 ] , POND [ 20 ] , CoSTCo [ 19 ] , EnergyTD [ 21 ] , and ScoreTR [ 22 ] . We evaluate factor dimensions R ∈ { 3 , 5 , 8 , 10 } R\in\{3,5,8,10\} for all applicable methods. POND is omitted from ACC because of its reported computational and memory requirements in this setting.

blocks.en: Table I shows that DiffTR achieves the lowest mean RMSE in all eight dataset–rank comparisons and the lowest mean MAE in seven; ScoreTR leads MAE on Alog at R = 3 R=3 . At R = 10 R=10 , DiffTR reduces RMSE relative to ScoreTR, the strongest baseline, by 3.2% on Alog and 8.8% on ACC. Its RMSE decreases as R R increases on both datasets, showing that the learned factor interactions effectively use additional representation capacity. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of DiffTR’s shared-factor-conditioned diffusion for recovering sparsely observed multiway data.

We next consider two timestamped tensors. Air is the Beijing air-quality dataset [ 51 ] , containing approximately 10 4 10^{4} observations over 12 12 sites and 6 6 pollutants. Click is an advertising click-through tensor [ 29 ] with 7 7 banner positions, 2842 2842 site domains, and 4127 4127 mobile applications, and contains approximately 5 × 10 4 5\times 10^{4} timestamped observations. We follow the split of [ 29 ] and report five-fold cross-validation results.
We compare DiffTR with CTCP [ 28 ] , CTGP [ 1 ] , CTNN [ 19 ] , NNDTN and NONFAT [ 29 ] , THIS-ODE [ 30 ] , EnergyTD [ 21 ] , and ScoreTR [ 22 ] . These baselines span spline-based factor trajectories, Gaussian processes, recurrent and ordinary-differential-equation dynamics, and undirected generative models.

blocks.en: Table II shows that DiffTR achieves the lowest mean RMSE and MAE on both datasets at every tested factor dimension. On Air at R = 5 R=5 , it reduces RMSE and MAE relative to ScoreTR by 10.8% and 15.9%, respectively. Its RMSE remains within 0.229–0.235 on Air and 1.337–1.342 on Click, indicating limited sensitivity to the tested factor dimensions. Together with the discrete-tensor results, these gains demonstrate that DiffTR incorporates temporal coordinates within the same conditional representation while maintaining competitive accuracy with compact factors.

blocks.en: Tables III and IV show that DiffTR achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, and NRMSE across all 30 combinations of modality, sampling rate, and observation pattern. At a 5% entry-wise sampling rate, it exceeds the strongest baseline in PSNR by 1.28 dB on RGB images, 0.53 dB on MSIs, and 0.50 dB on videos. For tube-wise MSI recovery, it outperforms FA-INR by 2.63–2.80 dB across the tested sampling rates. The reconstructions in Figure 2 further illustrate its preservation of object boundaries and local detail. Together, these results demonstrate that DiffTR effectively recovers both missing entries and tubes across diverse tensor modalities within a common conditional diffusion formulation.

blocks.en: We introduced DiffTR, a unified tensor recovery framework built on shared-factor-conditioned score learning. The same representation supports scalar entries and vector-valued tubes, while task-specific observation models extend recovery from completion to mixed-noise denoising and HSI super-resolution. Likelihood fitting and proximal correction accommodate corruption models, and optional spatial consistency provides a coordinate-based alternative to TV. Experiments across tabular tensors, images, and videos demonstrate the framework’s broad applicability, competitive recovery quality, and efficient neural representation. This separation of representation learning and observation modeling provides a foundation for extending DiffTR to additional tensor structures and inverse problems.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了DiffTR,一个基于共享因子条件的分数学习的统一抗热恢复框架. 同样的表示支持scalar录入和矢量值的管,而任务特定的观测模型将恢复从完成扩展到混合噪声解析和HSI超解. 相似性和近缘性矫正适应了腐败模式,可选的空间一致性为电视提供了一个基于坐标的替代方案。 横跨表格显示器、图像和视频的实验表明,该框架具有广泛的适用性、竞争性恢复质量以及高效的神经表现。 这种代表学习和观察模型的分离为将DiffTR扩展到额外的拉伸结构和反向问题提供了基础.

WDC uses the transposed 191 × 8 191\times 8 SRF_matrix.mat from TenFuse , preserving weights and band order. C.5 Baseline Budgets and Resource Measurement
blocks.zh: C.5 基线预算和资源衡量

blocks.en: Baselines receive DiffTR’s measured initialization-and-training time for each scene and setting. CS2DIPs selects the lowest observed-data Huber loss within 5,000 updates; GTNN and GNLTN allow up to 100 and 50 iterations. Their implementations use Lloyd clustering, bicubic initialization, matched degradation operators, and CPU LAPACK SVD for selected operations. EDIP-Net allocates 2 / 9 2/9 of its budget to stage two (at most 4,000 updates) and the remainder to stage three; learning rate 0.004 is constant for half of each phase, then decays linearly. Allocation rules and architectures are fixed, and retained outputs satisfy both time and iteration limits.
blocks.zh: DiffTR的基线为每个场景和设置提供了测量的初始化和训练时间。 CS2DIP在5000个更新中选择观测到的最低数据Huber损失;GTNN和GNLTN允许最多100个和50个迭代. 其执行使用劳埃德集群,双立方初始化,匹配降解操作器,以及用于选定操作的CPU LAPACK SVD. EDIP-Net将其预算的2 / 9/ 2/9分配给第二阶段(最多4000个更新),其余部分分配给第三阶段;每个阶段的一半学习率0.004不变,然后呈线性衰减. 分配规则和结构是固定的,保留的产出既满足时间限制,也满足迭代限制。

blocks.en: Profiling uses RTX 3090 GPUs, two CPU threads, one process per device, a three-second warm-up, and CUDA-synchronized timing. Baselines have T rec = T opt T_{\rm rec}=T_{\rm opt} ; DiffTR also includes basis estimation, operator setup, sampling, and refinement. Training and inference may use different GPUs of the same model. Loading, evaluation, and file I/O are excluded. Parameter counts cover network weights, including both EDIP-Net networks, but exclude optimized inputs, EMA copies, optimizer states, and buffers. Peak GPU memory is the largest allocated value per dataset; DiffTR uses the larger training or standalone-inference peak after releasing the optimizer. CUDA context memory, unused allocator reservations, and CPU SVD memory are excluded.
